audit_name: Multi-Layered Data Contamination, Near-Duplicate Detection, and Privacy De-Identification Audit

detection_layers.mechanism: Direct string match on (candidate_id, job_id) compound keys
detection_layers.false_negative_risk: High (Fails if IDs are regenerated or re-indexed across releases)

detection_layers.mechanism: SHA-256 computed on lowercased, whitespace-stripped text for both resumes and job descriptions
detection_layers.false_negative_risk: Moderate (Fails if trivial edits, punctuation, or disclaimer footers are modified)

detection_layers.mechanism: 128 permutation hashes, character 5-gram shingles, Jaccard similarity threshold = 0.85
detection_layers.false_positive_risk: Moderate (~2-5% on short job descriptions sharing boilerplate EEO statements)

detection_layers.mechanism: Human auditor inspection of all candidate-job pairs exhibiting Jaccard similarity between 0.70 and 0.85
detection_layers.purpose: Catches subtle template reuse, shared corporate job templates with differing titles, and localized candidate resume revisions

multi_layered_leakage_detection.quarantine_rule: Any benchmark pair exhibiting >= 0.85 Jaccard similarity or identical normalized text with ANY historical training, validation, or test split is PERMANENTLY QUARANTINED and EXCLUDED.

privacy_and_deidentification_framework.philosophical_framing: PII scrubbing via automated NER and regex is a RISK REDUCTION strategy, NOT a guarantee of mathematical anonymization.
automated_scrubbing_pipeline: Named Entity Recognition (NER) pipeline (Spacy/Transformers) scrubbing candidate names, organization names, and geographic addresses.
Regex filtering for telephone numbers, email addresses, social security numbers, postal codes, and URLs (GitHub, LinkedIn, personal portfolios).
Sanitization of recruiter signatures, hiring company contact details, and internal ATS requisition numbers.

residual_pii_threat_model.threat_1_niche_employer_inference: A candidate listing a niche startup with < 5 employees can be re-identified via LinkedIn search even without their personal name.
residual_pii_threat_model.threat_2_rare_academic_trajectory: Rare combinations of degrees, thesis titles, and publication years allow indirect demographic re-identification.
residual_pii_threat_model.threat_3_boilerplate_omission: Unusual contact formatting (e.g. phone numbers written as 'call 415 dot 555 dot 0199') may bypass standard regexes.

defense_in_depth_safeguards: Layer 1: Automated NER and Regex Sanitization Pipeline.
Layer 2: 10% Random Sampling Manual Residual-PII Inspection prior to annotator queue ingestion.
Layer 3: Restricted Access Control — Raw unscrubbed source datasets stored in an encrypted vault with strict read-only authorization.
Layer 4: Annotator Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and Terms of Service prohibiting reverse-engineering candidate identities.
